docno: Best Henna Tattoo Designs and Ideas
text: Although they are expensive and painful to obtain, tattoos have become very popular in recent years, especially for the young generation. Tattoos are permanent marks on skin that are made by craftsman. have appeared in many different cultures and countries although the attitudes toward vary from one country to another. We can consider some of the to be marks of beauty while some of the tattoos have significant meaning in different countries and culture Some people, especially girls like on their body parts. The concept of having henna comes from ancient cultures but now it is used everywhere around the world. In ancient traditions henna was designed at the time of marriage on the bride’s hand and legs. But nowadays henna can also be considered as a tattoo. Henna tattoo designs are temporary marks on the skin. They can be removed easily and thus do not last long. Henna tattoo designs are created for advertising, especially for novelty items. Today most of these tattoos are used in the fine art of lithography. Today most tattoo parlors can produce these types of henna tattoos. Henna tattoos are also called . It is a distinct type of henna tattoo coming from the South Asian area. can be about the traditional practices of cultures of the people in the mid east parts of Asia that was passed on from era to era, about glamorizing the overall look of your personality and a significant dorm of physique artwork or about creative appearances.  In those days, men and women wore various patterns on their bodies. It was an important tradition in most social events, marriages in addition to other festivities. has been around for some time now. It just did not have that kind of popularity, as compared to ink tattoos. It was occasionally sported by pop stars and famous actors. However, with increase in experimentation and tattoo artists searching for newer techniques and designs and materials, henna came to the forefront. Ink tattoos have a problem that they are permanent and most people don’t like that. They want something that is fashionable and yet temporary. Also ink tattoo is harmful for skin, so henna tattoo can be considered as a good substitute. henna technique superior to ink tattoos is the fact it really is more secure. It is made of organic components such as mehendi leaves as well as other lesser known substitute such as henna, eucalyptus, lavender as well as coconut oil, dark java or liquefied tea leaves. Natural henna does not have any synthetic compounds added, though people may want alternatives in color. Nonetheless, scientific tests have demonstrated that henna is completely risk free, except in some very rare cases when it may lead to epidermal irritation to those who have allergic reactions to henna. Even then, the irritation is minor and easily cured. , henna tattoos do not involve injecting henna in the skin. Done by natural means, there is no discomfort as that in ink tattooing where etching on the epidermis can be quite hurtful in addition to the irritation. Due to the fact henna tattoo is made of organic components it’s comparatively less costly. Needles are not used and so there is no health risk whatsoever, apart from minor irritation to a very few who may have allergic reactions. However what makes henna tattoo significantly popular over other ones, among tattoo aficionados is the fact that it is really short-term. Henna substance leaves brownish or red coloration after it dries out and is washed away. If done properly, can last for two to three weeks, providing ample time to show it off. Since it is short term, the tattoo design can be changes whenever you want and thus provide endless options to mix and match with the occasion and dressing. To get a good and dark color you have to be aware of some dos and don’ts. First you have to put little bit of oil at the desired part and then put mehendi over it, after that keep it for at least 3 hours. After removing it put some lemon juice over it. And one thing keep in mind is that do not wash that part at least for 7 to 8 hours after wiping out the henna. After that you will notice that your henna color become as dark as you want. Henna tattoo can have many elegant design patterns like flowers, peacock, your zodiac sign, your name and many more. You can take any design you want. Also you can have the tattoo anywhere you want like at your feet, your palm, shoulders and back. Also henna is known to provide a cooling effect to the area where it is applied. I love Henna tattoo designs in all forms. Comments are closed.
